algorithms.note: ed25519 is the authenticating algorithm; additive post-quantum cosignatures may appear on checkpoints and are not required for quorum

rotation_rule: log key rotation is valid only if recorded in-log as a log-key-rotation/v1 leaf; revocation as log-key-revocation/v1; a successor manifest MUST carry previous_manifest_sha256 of this manifest, MUST be signed by an ed25519 log key valid under its predecessor (or cite the rotation leaf index that replaced it), and MUST appear at https://markovianprotocol.com/.well-known/trust-root/<version>.json

publication.log_leaf: the sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonicalization of this manifest WITHOUT the signature field is appended to the log as a trust-root-manifest/v1 leaf

signature.signed_over: RFC 8785 canonicalization of the manifest without this signature field
